factProposals.value: A public hospital can genuinely have fewer than three fiscal years of cost report data even after the 3-year HCRIS import (e.g. ANSON GENERAL HOSPITAL, CCN 670781, has only FY2024 and FY2025 on record, not FY2023).

decisions.statement: The public frontend reads hospital data through @supabase/supabase-js (anon/publishable key, PostgREST) rather than a direct Postgres connection, even though a working DATABASE_URL connection string already existed locally.
decisions.rationale: Vercel serverless functions are ephemeral and scale out horizontally; a direct Postgres connection per invocation exhausts Supabase's direct-connection limit under real traffic. Supabase's own pooler/REST layer exists specifically so serverless clients avoid this. This also matches the story's own task guidance to use Supabase, not just any Postgres connection.

decisions.statement: Hospital name search is case-insensitive partial matching (ilike), not an exact-name match.
decisions.rationale: Public users searching by memory will not know a hospital's exact CMS-registered name string; requiring an exact match would make the free public search practically unusable.

decisions.statement: The acceptance criterion 'notes public data lag' is implemented as a static disclosure sentence about CMS's filing-and-processing delay, not a computed per-hospital lag figure.
decisions.rationale: There is no per-row lag timestamp in the source data to compute an actual lag from; inventing one would be an ungrounded number, which the project's own grounding guardrail (REQ-004) exists to prevent.

limitations.statement: The public trend view shows only the three financial metrics from STORY-002 (operating margin, days cash on hand, days in AR) and collapses any missing value to a plain 'not available' -- it does not surface the per-metric provenance/not_reported reasons that STORY-001/002 already store in the database.

There is no exact-name-to-single-hospital shortcut: a name search always returns a results list (even a list of one), and the three-year trend view is only reached from that list or by direct provider_ccn URL.
